title: When Log Parsing Removes What Matters: Detecting Failures in Distributed GPU Workloads
abstract: arXiv:2610.14009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large AI models increasingly rely on distributed GPU execution, yet it remains unclear whether established failure analysis methods transfer effectively to this setting. We introduce GF-Bench, a PyTorch-based framework and dataset for generating diverse failures in distributed GPU workloads. The framework supports extensible workload and fault-injection logic; based on this design, the current release targets failures visible in multi-GPU communication logs and provides 220 labeled two-GPU executions covering normal runs, CUDA out-of-memory fail-stop failures, and persistent straggler fail-slow failures. Using GF-Bench, we evaluate three sequence-based methods (DeepLog, LogAnomaly, and LogBERT) and the LLM-based LogPrompt on parsed logs, and additionally evaluate LogPrompt on raw logs. translated_title: 当日志解析丢失关键信息时：分布式GPU工作负载中的故障检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.14009v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型AI模型越来越依赖分布式GPU执行，然而既有的故障分析方法能否有效迁移到这一场景仍不清楚。我们提出了GF-Bench，一个基于PyTorch的框架和数据集，用于在分布式GPU工作负载中生成多样化的故障。该框架支持可扩展的工作负载与故障注入逻辑；基于该设计，当前版本针对多GPU通信日志中可见的故障，提供了220个带标签的双GPU执行记录，涵盖正常运行、CUDA内存耗尽的fail-stop故障，以及持续性掉队节点的fail-slow故障。利用GF-Bench，我们在解析后的日志上评估了三种基于序列的方法（DeepLog、LogAnomaly和LogBERT）以及基于大语言模型的LogPrompt，并额外在原始日志上评估了LogPrompt。在解析后的输入上，没有任何方法能够可靠地同时检测这两类故障，最高的整体F1分数仅为0.667。而使用原始输入则提升了...的整体F1分数。
tldr: 该论文提出GF-Bench故障注入框架，通过在分布式GPU工作负载中生成220个带标签的故障样本进行评估，发现日志解析会丢失关键故障信息，导致现有日志异常检测方法无法可靠识别多GPU通信中的fail-stop和fail-slow故障。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces GF-Bench, a PyTorch-based fault-injection framework with 220 labeled two-GPU executions, demonstrating that log parsing removes critical failure information, causing existing log anomaly detection methods to fail at reliably detecting both fail-stop and fail-slow failures in distributed GPU communication.
